_comment: Fleet-wide compose defaults merged into every service by engine.nix (see _shared/engine.nix:73-117 mergeSvc → lib.recursiveUpdate). A service's own composeSpec field overrides the corresponding default. Test gate: _shared/test-dist-v2.sh:105-150 asserts every field appears in every rendered docker-compose.yml. ─── init: true ─── Docker injects tini (~30 KB) as PID 1 inside every container; tini reaps orphaned children. Fixes the zombie-accumulation class of bug that caused Dagu's pids.max:256 saturation 2026-04-29. Containers with their own init system (s6-overlay, supervisord, systemd-in-container) override with init: false in their compose.nix. ─── logging max-size: 10m × max-file: 7 ─── ≈ 7 days of retention for typical low-traffic containers; high-traffic rotates faster (json-file driver is size-triggered, not time-triggered). Total cap per container: 70 MB. Per-VM disk headroom is bounded by disk-watchdog tiers at 85/90/95% (b_infra/home-manager/_shared/modules/system-protection-watchdog-petter-dropbear-health-agent.nix).
